{
  "info": {
    "title": "Consent Manager API",
    "description": "This document provides an API description in [OpenAPI](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.0.1.html)
for the Consent Manager API.

These APIs are implemented by Ozone and should be called by the financial institution to find, modify and delete consents.

### Versioning

The `version` property implements the following pattern `{standards-major}.{standards-minor}.{ozone-connect-version}`, where:

* `standards-major` is the major version of the latest UAE standard that the API description implements.

* `standards-minor` is the minor version of the latest UAE standard that the API description implements.

* `ozone-connect-version` is the version of the Ozone Connect API description.

So, for example, `.1` indicates the first version of the Ozone Connect API description that implements the UAE standard version 2.0.
### v2.1.10
* Added a character-set `pattern` (`^[A-Za-z0-9 \/?:().,'+-]+$`, the ISO 20022 / SWIFT "x" set) to the
  current (free-text, 35-char) branch of the Creditor and Debtor references
  (`AEServiceInitiationCreditorReference` / `AEServiceInitiationDebtorReference`), so every LFI knows
  exactly which characters it must accept and store. The deprecated structured (120-char) branch is
  unchanged. Per OFP-003.

### v2.1.9
* Restructured the international Creditor PII (`PersonalIdentifiableInformation.Initiation.Creditor`) for
  SWIFT SR2026: the Creditor party is now a `oneOf` of Individual and Organization variants, discriminated
  by `IdentityType`.


* The Individual variant carries object-valued `FirstName` / `MiddleName` / `LastName` (`en` / `ar` / `ls`),
  `RelationshipToSender`, `DateOfBirth`, `Occupation`, `Nationality`, `Gender`, `CountryOfBirth`,
  `SourceOfIncome`, `SourceOfFunds`, and `Evidence`. The Organization variant carries `AnyBIC`, `LEI`, and
  `Identification` + `SchemeName`. Both variants share `MobileNumber` / `Email` and an object-valued `Name`
  (`en` / `ar` / `ls`).


* Added SWIFT SR2026 fields to the international `PostalAddress` (`PostCode`, `Room`, `Department`,
  `SubDepartment`, `TownLocationName`, and now-mandatory `TownName`). It is now a single
  `AEInternationalAddress` schema shared by both the Creditor and the Creditor Agent (the Creditor Agent
  previously used the legacy `AEAddress`).


* Added a `CreditorAgent.Branch` object and `CreditorAccount.AccountType` (Savings / Current / Checking /
  Prepaid). Domestic Creditor schemas are unchanged.


### v2.1.8
* Aligned `AEBankServiceInitiationRichAuthorizationRequests.AECreditorIndicators.AccountType` enum with Standards (Retail / SME / Corporate), replacing the previous product-category enum (CurrentAccount / Savings / CreditCard / Mortgage / Finance) that diverged from the Standards PAR + Payments specs.

* Aligned the `Risk` object with Standards: tightened `AERisk` and its descendants on the payment-initiation side with `additionalProperties: false` throughout, carved out the three `SupplementaryData` blocks on the RAR-shape (`AEBankServiceInitiationRichAuthorizationRequests.AE*Indicators.SupplementaryData`) to be open extension points (no `additionalProperties: false`), and added `minLength: 1` / `maxLength: 70` to `AddressLine` items inside the legacy `AEAddress` variant.

* Added `ReadStatements` and `ReadProductFinanceRates` to `AEAccountAccessConsentPermissionCodes`, which were present in the v2.1 Standards Bank Data Sharing permission set but missing from the Consent Manager. The Consent Manager must accept every permission code from all supported Standards versions.

* Closed the three `ConsentManager.AE*ConsentUpdateProperties` schemas with `additionalProperties: false`. The `PATCH /consents/{consentId}` request body is an `anyOf` of one schema per consent type (Bank Data Sharing, Bank Service Initiation, Insurance Data Sharing); without this, unknown properties were silently accepted, so a field belonging to one consent type could be patched onto another. The schemas now enforce the per-type field separation they describe.

* Reverted the payment-log reject reason code to match the v2.0.x Consent Manager: the top-level property is `rejectReasonCode` (not `RejectReasonCode`) on the `GET /payment-log` response and `PATCH /payment-log/{id}` request body, and the `code` / `message` fields inside `CbuaePaymentLogRejectReasonCode` items are lower-case again (not `Code` / `Message`). The PascalCase variants were introduced in error and broke LFIs built against the v2.0.x payment-log contract.

### v2.1.7
* Added `SME` to `AEExternalAccountTypeCode`.

* Changed the `Amount` schema `pattern` regex, which was over-escaped in YAML and failed to validate decimal 
  monetary values.


* Removed the unused `AEBankServiceInitiationRichAuthorizationRequests.AERiskExternalAccountIdentificationCode` 
  schema, which duplicated `AERiskExternalAccountIdentificationCode` and was never referenced.


### v2.1.6
* Added revised PII properties compatible with version 2.1.

* Changed DebtorReference and CreditorReference to reflect v2.0 properties.

* Changed Rich Authorization Request `type` values to reflect exactly the consent type they are describing.

* Removed changelog before v2.1.4 to reduce bloat of API description.
### v2.1.5
* Changed Account Opening Statuses to provide correct status codes for `patch /account-opening-log/{logId}`.
### v2.1.4
* Added `FromDate` and `ToDate` in Bank Data Sharing Consents.
* Changed `TransactionFromDateTime` and `TransactionToDateTime` to `deprecated` in Bank Data Sharing Consents in
  line with changes in v2.1 Pushed Authorization Requests.

Get Consent by ID > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEConsentStatus

{
  "description": "Specifies the status of a payment consent.\n\n| Consent Status| State Type| Description|\n|---------------|-----------|------|\n| AwaitingAuthorization | Pending | The consent is awaiting authorization.|\n| Authorized | In Use | The consent has been successfully authorized.|\n| Rejected | Terminal | The unauthorized consent has been rejected at the LFI.|\n| Revoked | Terminal | The consent has been revoked at the TPP or LFI.|\n| Expired | Terminal | The consent is now expired.|\n| Consumed | Terminal | The consented action(s) have either been completed successfully.|\n| Suspended | In Use | The consent has been suspended, pending further enquiries.|\n",
  "type": "string",
  "enum": [
    "AwaitingAuthorization",
    "Authorized",
    "Rejected",
    "Revoked",
    "Expired",
    "Consumed",
    "Suspended"
  ]
}
